token_budget_basis.node_purpose: Recompile five immutable R2 source responses after bounding PDF header-date scope, correcting Dell IR and Mississippi Board Book dates without issuing another network or model call.
token_budget_basis.input_scale_basis: One digest-bound R2 terminal, one effective capture plan, five successful immutable response captures, the R2 date defect receipt and the failed R3 replay preflight finding.
token_budget_basis.schema_burden: The replay must distinguish first-page title/header dates from later contextual dates, preserve both visible and file-metadata candidates, prove two explicit corrections and preserve three unaffected source object digests.
token_budget_basis.materiality_and_quality_risk: An over-wide visible-header window can mistake research-event dates for publication dates; an over-narrow correction scope can preserve a known one-day Board Book date error; silent refetching would break exact failure lineage.
token_budget_basis.comparable_run_evidence: R3 preflight proved that a 1,200-character window incorrectly captured PT research/update dates, while a 240-character window retains Dell, Mississippi and CMBI title/header dates. It also proved the Mississippi visible date is 2025-02-20 and provider-corroborated.
token_budget_basis.reasoning_profile: Deterministic AI-free capture validation and compilation replay only.
token_budget_basis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Abort unless all five predecessor captures are digest-bound and reused, no transport executes, exactly Dell and Mississippi receive the registered dates, and PT, CMBI and NVIDIA source object digests remain unchanged; preserve R2 and failed R3.
